items.where: the intro screen, under DUMMIES, before the mode select: the one line that tells a new trainee what to do, in both modes. Facts: you are a crash-test dummy in training; you want the cars to hit you; the cars avoid you; combos score more; equipment comes with progress
items.text: Farsight tests the player in Chongqing. Get hit, chain combos, respawn with three lives and level up.
